description: Look up the qualifying notes that condition Codex GSFA food additive provisions. GSFA provisions are frequently limited by numbered notes such as "for use in ready-to-drink products only", "as sulphur dioxide", or "on the fat basis", and a maximum use level is not fully specified without them. Give note numbers to resolve, or a search term to find notes by their wording.

query.description: Find notes whose text contains this wording, e.g. "sulphur dioxide".

name: gsfa_notes
title: Gsfa Notes
